cohort: 111,315 women who delivered infants in 39 hospitals in 14 provinces in China during 2011
finding: The study found a high overall CS rate in mainland China, with CDMR being the most common indication, suggesting that it is a significant contributor to the increasing CS rate.
mod_finding: CDMR was the most common indication for cesarean section, accounting for 28.43% of all cesarean deliveries.
